title: Paleolithic flutes in German caves
summary: Flutes from caves in Germany, about 42,000 years old, are among the earliest known musical instruments.
why: Music was part of human life by this time.

notes.problem: Cited source says only 'Paleolithic flutes in Germany'; Hohle Fels page: 'oldest known uncontested musical instrument'; Divje Babe claim disputed. Jiahu flutes not shown independent.
Cited source says only 'Paleolithic flutes in Germany'; 'oldest uncontested', bone/ivory and the Slovenia flute are not in it.
